subject: Password expired and the new one keeps getting rejected
description: I got the expiry warning and tried to set a new password but it keeps telling me it doesn't meet requirements, even though I'm following the rules on screen.
resolution_steps: Verified requester identity via the registered recovery phone number.
Identified the new password was being rejected because it reused a value from the password history.
Guided requester through choosing a password not previously used on the account.
Confirmed successful login before closing the ticket.
resolution_summary: Password reset completed after identifying password-history reuse as the cause of rejection.

subject: Can't sign in since the password policy changed
description: After the announcement about the new password rules I can't log in anymore on my laptop. My old password worked fine on Friday.
resolution_steps: Verified identity via employee ID cross-checked against the HR directory.
Confirmed the account was flagged for a mandatory password change under the updated policy.
Issued a self-service reset link to the registered recovery email.
Confirmed requester completed the reset and logged in successfully.
resolution_summary: Mandatory policy-driven password change completed via self-service reset link.

subject: Password not accepted and I have a customer escalation call in 20 minutes
description: I need to get into the support console for a scheduled customer call shortly and my password isn't being accepted. This is time critical.
resolution_steps: Verified identity urgently through the requester's direct manager on the same call.
Confirmed account was not locked and no suspicious-activity flag was present.
Issued a temporary password with forced change at next login.
Confirmed access to the support console restored before the scheduled call.
resolution_summary: Expedited password reset handled at P2 due to an imminent customer commitment; identity verification was expedited, not skipped.

subject: Reset link is being sent to an old personal email
description: The password reset keeps going to a personal email address I don't use anymore, so I never receive it. Can you update where it gets sent?
resolution_steps: Verified identity via employee badge number cross-checked against the HR directory.
Updated the registered recovery email address on the account.
Re-triggered the reset workflow to the corrected address.
Confirmed the requester received the link and completed the reset.
resolution_summary: Recovery email address updated after identity verification; reset completed successfully.

subject: Locked out after trying to log in on my tablet
description: I was setting up email on my work tablet and typed the wrong password several times, now the account is locked everywhere.
resolution_steps: Verified identity through the registered recovery phone number.
Confirmed lockout was caused by 5 consecutive failed attempts, consistent with the standard threshold.
Confirmed no suspicious-activity flag was raised by the identity provider.
Unlocked the account and assisted with the tablet mail setup to prevent recurrence.
resolution_summary: Account unlocked after ordinary failed-attempt lockout; root cause was manual entry errors during device setup.

subject: Switched to a new phone and the authenticator app is empty
description: I moved to a new phone over the weekend and the authenticator app has none of my accounts in it, so I can't approve any login.
resolution_steps: Performed enhanced identity verification via video confirmation plus employee badge.
Issued a temporary backup code valid for 24 hours.
Created a follow-up task for the requester to re-enroll the new device in the authenticator app.
Confirmed successful login and completion of device re-enrollment.
resolution_summary: Backup MFA code issued after enhanced identity verification; new device re-enrolled within the 24-hour window.

subject: MFA push notifications never arrive on my phone
description: When I log in the site says it sent a push notification but nothing shows up on my phone. I have to wait for it to time out every time.
resolution_steps: Confirmed the account was correctly enrolled and no lockout was in place.
Identified that background notifications were disabled for the authenticator app at OS level.
Guided requester through re-enabling notifications and background refresh.
Verified a test push notification arrived and was approved successfully.
resolution_summary: Resolved by re-enabling OS-level notifications for the authenticator app; no account changes required.

subject: New intern starting Monday needs an account set up
description: We have an intern joining the HR team next Monday who needs a standard account, email, and access to the team shared drive.
resolution_steps: Confirmed the request came from the hiring manager of the relevant department.
Confirmed the requested resources match the standard access profile for the role.
Provisioned the account with standard collaboration tools and department shared drive access.
Sent onboarding credentials securely to the manager for first-day hand-off.
resolution_summary: Standard account provisioned against the role's default access profile; no additional approval required.

subject: Need access to the internal engineering wiki space
description: I can see the main wiki but not the platform team's space, which I need for the onboarding docs on our services.
resolution_steps: Confirmed the request came from the employee and matched their team assignment.
Confirmed the wiki space is a standard collaboration resource, not a sensitive system.
Added the requester to the appropriate access group.
Confirmed the requester could open the space and its onboarding documentation.
resolution_summary: Standard collaboration-tool access granted after confirming role appropriateness.

subject: Analyst needs access to the customer payment processing system
description: One of my analysts is taking over chargeback reconciliation and needs access to the payment processing system. I've approved it on my side, we need this before month end.
resolution_steps: Confirmed the requested system stores customer payment information and is therefore classified as sensitive.
Verified the requesting manager's approval was present but the system-owner approval was missing.
Escalated to a human agent, drafting the access request and identifying the missing approval rather than granting access.
Access granted at read-only scope once the system owner countersigned.
resolution_summary: Escalated for the missing second approval; access granted only after dual approval was complete.
escalation_reason: Access to a system storing customer payment information requires dual approval (manager and system owner); only manager approval was attached.

subject: Need access to the shared procurement templates folder
description: My colleagues can open the templates folder for supplier contracts but I get an access denied message.
resolution_steps: Confirmed the folder is a standard department shared resource.
Confirmed the requester belongs to the procurement department.
Added the requester to the department's shared drive group.
Confirmed the requester could open and edit the template files.
resolution_summary: Department shared drive access granted; request fell within standard, non-sensitive access.

subject: Team member leaving at the end of the month, please process exit
description: One of my reps has resigned and their last working day is the 31st. HR asked me to open a ticket so IT can handle the account and equipment.
resolution_steps: Confirmed the termination date against the HR record.
Scheduled account deactivation for end of business on the last working day.
Configured mailbox forwarding to the requesting manager for 30 days.
Generated the equipment return checklist for laptop, headset, and badge.
resolution_summary: Standard voluntary exit processed per the offboarding procedure; deactivation scheduled and mail forwarding configured.

subject: Immediate access revocation required, employee dismissed this morning
description: We have concluded a dismissal effective immediately. All system access and building access must be revoked now, signed notice is attached.
resolution_steps: Verified the request against the signed HR involuntary-termination notice.
Escalated as a mandatory action and immediately disabled all system accounts, VPN, and badge access.
Notified security and facilities of the access change.
Logged the full action timeline with timestamps for the compliance audit trail.
resolution_summary: Same-hour revocation of all access completed under the involuntary termination protocol, with escalated logging for audit.
escalation_reason: Involuntary termination offboarding is a mandatory escalation trigger and must be logged as an escalated action for the compliance audit trail regardless of resolution speed.

subject: Laptop shuts down by itself during video calls
description: My laptop powers off completely with no warning, usually a few minutes into a call. It has happened four times in two days.
resolution_steps: Performed a power cycle and hard reset with the requester on the call.
Inspected running processes remotely and found thermal shutdown events in the system logs.
Confirmed a hardware cooling fault rather than a software issue.
Issued a loaner laptop the same day and scheduled the unit for depot repair.
resolution_summary: Thermal shutdown traced to a cooling fault; loaner issued immediately and original unit sent to depot repair.

subject: Laptop has become extremely slow since the last update
description: Everything takes ages since the update last week, opening a browser tab can take half a minute. I can still work but it's painful.
resolution_steps: Inspected running processes remotely and identified a search indexing service stuck at high CPU.
Restarted the indexing service and rebuilt its index.
Cleared temporary update files left over from the previous installation.
Confirmed normal performance with the requester after a restart.
resolution_summary: Performance restored by rebuilding a stuck indexing service; no hardware fault found.

subject: Battery drains in under an hour when unplugged
description: My laptop used to last most of the day and now it barely lasts an hour away from the charger. It's about three years old.
resolution_steps: Reviewed the battery health report and confirmed capacity had degraded below the serviceable threshold.
Confirmed the device was within the standard 4-year refresh cycle, so battery replacement rather than device replacement applied.
Scheduled depot repair for battery replacement.
Issued a loaner for the repair window given the requester's active business need.
resolution_summary: Degraded battery scheduled for depot replacement with a loaner issued; device retained as it is within the refresh cycle.

subject: Dropped my laptop and now the screen has coloured lines
description: I knocked my laptop off the desk this morning. It still turns on but there are vertical coloured lines across half the screen.
resolution_steps: Instructed requester to power the device down immediately and not restart it, per physical damage guidance.
Routed the device directly to depot repair without attempting remote troubleshooting.
Depot confirmed a damaged display panel and replaced it.
Issued a loaner for the duration of the repair.
resolution_summary: Physical damage case sent straight to depot repair; display panel replaced and loaner issued during turnaround.

subject: Printer is asking for a PIN I was never given
description: The printer on our floor now asks for a release PIN before printing and I don't have one, so my documents just sit in the queue.
resolution_steps: Confirmed secure print release had been enabled on the floor printer.
Generated the requester's personal print release PIN.
Guided the requester through releasing the queued documents.
Confirmed all pending jobs printed successfully.
resolution_summary: Print release PIN issued after secure printing was enabled; queued jobs released successfully.

subject: Scan to email isn't delivering anything to my inbox
description: I scan documents on the floor multifunction printer and pick my name from the list, but nothing ever arrives in my mailbox.
resolution_steps: Confirmed the scan job completed successfully on the device side.
Found the device address book still held the requester's former email alias.
Updated the address book entry with the current mailbox address.
Confirmed a test scan was delivered successfully.
resolution_summary: Resolved by correcting an outdated address book entry on the multifunction device.

subject: Printer produces completely blank pages
description: The printer takes the paper and goes through the whole cycle but every page comes out blank. Toner was replaced recently.
resolution_steps: Confirmed toner levels were adequate via the printer admin panel.
Found the protective seal had not been removed from the recently installed toner cartridge.
Coordinated with facilities to remove the seal and reseat the cartridge.
Ran a test print confirming normal output.
resolution_summary: Blank output caused by a protective seal left on a new toner cartridge; resolved after reseating.

subject: Headset microphone isn't recognised in calls
description: People can't hear me on calls when I use my headset. The audio output works fine, it's only the microphone that isn't picked up.
resolution_steps: Tested the headset on a different USB port to isolate the connection.
Confirmed the headset microphone was not selected as the default input device.
Updated the audio driver and set the correct default input device.
Confirmed a successful test call with the requester.
resolution_summary: Resolved via audio driver update and correcting the default input device selection.

subject: Docking station has stopped charging my laptop
description: My dock still drives the monitors but the laptop no longer charges through it, so I have to use the power brick separately.
resolution_steps: Swap-tested the dock power supply with a known-working unit to isolate the faulty component.
Confirmed the dock's power adapter had failed while the dock itself remained functional.
Replaced the power adapter from existing inventory.
Confirmed charging and display output both working through the dock.
resolution_summary: Faulty dock power adapter replaced from inventory; no approval required as a standard peripheral.

subject: Requesting a keyboard and mouse for my hot desk
description: I've moved to the shared desk area which doesn't have peripherals, could I get a standard keyboard and mouse assigned to me?
resolution_steps: Confirmed the request was for standard peripherals within the standard allowance.
Confirmed availability in existing inventory.
Issued the peripherals and logged them against the requester's asset record.
Confirmed successful setup at the new desk.
resolution_summary: Standard peripherals issued from inventory; no approval required under the standard allowance.

subject: Requesting a high-spec workstation for model training workloads
description: My team needs a workstation with a dedicated GPU for local model training. The standard laptop can't handle it. Current machine is two years old and works fine otherwise.
resolution_steps: Confirmed the current device is under the 4-year refresh cycle and still functional.
Classified the request as non-standard, premium equipment outside the standard allowance.
Escalated to a human agent for approval rather than auto-approving the request.
Procurement proceeded once manager and IT asset owner approvals were both documented.
resolution_summary: Escalated for approval as a premium, non-standard equipment request on a device still within its refresh cycle.
escalation_reason: Hardware request exceeds the standard allowance and concerns a device under 4 years old that is still functional, requiring documented approval before fulfilment.

subject: Wi-Fi drops every time I move between floors
description: When I walk from the second floor to the third my laptop loses the connection and doesn't reconnect on its own, I have to toggle Wi-Fi off and on.
resolution_steps: Checked for known access point issues in the requester's building; none reported.
Reset the saved network profile on the laptop.
Updated the wireless adapter driver to the current approved version.
Confirmed the device roamed between access points without dropping over a full day.
resolution_summary: Roaming failures resolved by resetting the network profile and updating the wireless adapter driver.

subject: Need guest Wi-Fi codes for a client workshop tomorrow
description: We're hosting eight people from a client for a workshop tomorrow and they'll need internet access in the meeting room.
resolution_steps: Confirmed the request qualified for the standard time-limited guest access process.
Generated guest Wi-Fi access codes covering the workshop window.
Provided the codes to the requester ahead of the session.
resolution_summary: Time-limited guest Wi-Fi codes issued directly; no additional approval required for guest access.

subject: Wi-Fi is very slow but only in the afternoon
description: In the mornings everything is fine, but from about two o'clock onwards pages take forever to load. It happens to a couple of us in the same area.
resolution_steps: Confirmed the reports were localised to one seating area rather than building-wide, so no infrastructure incident was declared.
Ran a site survey and found access point congestion during peak occupancy hours.
Logged a facilities ticket for an additional access point in that area.
Provided wired connections as an interim workaround for the affected desks.
resolution_summary: Afternoon slowdown traced to access point congestion; interim wired workaround provided pending an additional access point.

subject: VPN won't connect from my hotel Wi-Fi
description: I'm travelling for a client visit and the VPN client just times out on the hotel network. I need the internal pricing tool this afternoon.
resolution_steps: Confirmed the issue was isolated to this user and no gateway-wide problem was reported.
Determined the hotel network was blocking the port used by the primary gateway.
Switched the requester to the alternate gateway configured for external and travel use.
Confirmed successful connection and access to internal tools.
resolution_summary: Resolved by switching to the alternate VPN gateway after confirming the hotel network blocked the primary port.

subject: VPN says connected but I can't reach the build server
description: The client shows an active tunnel but nothing internal resolves, the build server and the internal package registry both time out.
resolution_steps: Confirmed the VPN tunnel was active but internal name resolution was failing.
Reset the VPN client's DNS configuration, the most common root cause for this symptom.
Reconnected the tunnel and flushed the local DNS cache.
Confirmed the requester could reach the build server and package registry.
resolution_summary: Resolved via VPN client DNS configuration reset; tunnel was healthy but internal resolution was broken.

subject: Entire logistics team offline on VPN during the shipment cutoff window
description: None of my twelve team members can connect to the VPN this morning and we have a carrier cutoff at midday. This is blocking all outbound shipments.
resolution_steps: Confirmed multiple users were affected simultaneously, indicating a gateway-level rather than client-side fault.
Escalated immediately as a suspected infrastructure incident given multi-user impact and business-critical timing.
Coordinated with network engineering, who identified a failed certificate renewal on the gateway.
Confirmed service restoration with the affected team ahead of the carrier cutoff.
resolution_summary: Escalated as a P1 infrastructure incident; gateway certificate renewal failure resolved before the business-critical deadline.
escalation_reason: Multi-user VPN failure combined with a business-critical time window indicates potential infrastructure impact and triggers mandatory immediate escalation.

subject: Shared drive is crawling this morning
description: Opening the quarterly workbooks from the finance shared drive takes minutes today. Local files open instantly so it seems to be the drive.
resolution_steps: Checked shared drive server load before assuming a network fault.
Identified an archive job running against the same volume during business hours.
Rescheduled the archive job to run outside business hours.
Confirmed with the requester that file open times returned to normal.
resolution_summary: Slowness caused by an archive job running in business hours; resolved by rescheduling the job.

subject: Access denied on a contracts folder I opened yesterday
description: I could open the contracts archive folder yesterday afternoon and today it says access denied. Nothing changed on my side.
resolution_steps: Identified the symptom as an access change rather than a performance problem.
Reviewed recent permission changes and found a group membership cleanup had removed the requester.
Confirmed with the folder owner that access should be retained.
Restored the requester's group membership and confirmed access.
resolution_summary: Access restored after a routine permissions cleanup had inadvertently removed the requester's group membership.

subject: Need the approved database client installed
description: I need the standard database client to query our reporting replica, it isn't showing in the self-service catalog on my machine.
resolution_steps: Confirmed the application is on the approved software catalog.
Confirmed a license seat was available within the standard budget.
Deployed the application via the standard remote software deployment tool.
Confirmed successful installation and license activation with the requester.
resolution_summary: Approved catalog software deployed remotely and activated; no additional approval required.

subject: Need the statistical analysis tool from the catalog
description: I'm taking over the forecasting models and need the statistics package that the rest of the team already has.
resolution_steps: Confirmed the requested tool is on the approved software catalog.
Confirmed an unused license seat was available in the department's existing allocation.
Pushed the installation remotely and assigned the seat.
Confirmed the requester could open the tool and load an existing model file.
resolution_summary: Catalog software installed and licensed from the department's existing seat allocation.

subject: Requesting a video editing tool I used at my previous company
description: I'd like a specific video editing application installed for our campaign work. I don't think it's in the catalog but it's what I know best and we have deadlines.
resolution_steps: Checked the approved software catalog and confirmed the requested tool was not present.
Escalated by routing the request to the Software Approval Board for security and licensing review, without installing the software.
Explained the review process to the requester without promising an approval outcome.
Suggested an equivalent catalog application as an interim option while the review proceeds.
resolution_summary: Non-catalog request routed to the Software Approval Board; installation withheld pending security and licensing review.
escalation_reason: Requested software is not on the approved catalog and must be reviewed by the Software Approval Board before installation, regardless of urgency.

subject: My diagramming tool licence has expired
description: The diagramming application now opens in read-only mode and says my licence has expired. I use it for support escalation flowcharts.
resolution_steps: Confirmed the licence was part of the standard annual renewal cycle with budget already allocated.
Renewed the licence seat.
Confirmed the application unlocked and existing files remained editable.
resolution_summary: Licence renewed within the standard annual budget; no additional approval required.

subject: Need twelve additional seats on the analytics platform
description: We're standing up a new regional team and need twelve more seats on the analytics platform before their start date. This is well beyond what we currently have licensed.
resolution_steps: Compared requested seats against the department's current licensed count and annual software budget.
Confirmed the purchase would exceed the department's annual budget threshold.
Escalated to a human agent to obtain budget owner approval before purchasing.
Provisioned and assigned the seats once budget owner approval was documented.
resolution_summary: Escalated for budget owner approval as the purchase exceeded the department threshold; seats provisioned after sign-off.
escalation_reason: Additional licence seats exceed the department's annual software budget threshold and require documented budget owner approval before purchase.

subject: Accounting software crashes whenever I export a report
description: Every time I try to export the monthly report to PDF the application closes without warning. I can work otherwise but I can't deliver the report.
resolution_steps: Checked vendor release notes for known issues matching the export crash symptom.
Identified a known defect in the installed version affecting PDF export of large reports.
Applied the vendor-provided patch to the local installation.
Confirmed the export completed successfully on the same report.
resolution_summary: Resolved by applying a vendor patch for a known PDF export defect in the installed version.

subject: HR portal throws an error when I upload documents
description: Uploading a signed document to the HR portal gives a generic error message every time. Smaller files seem to work.
resolution_steps: Reproduced the error and confirmed it occurred only above a certain file size.
Checked known issues and found the upload size limit had been lowered by a recent configuration change.
Applied the corrected configuration restoring the intended limit.
Confirmed the requester could upload the original document successfully.
resolution_summary: Upload failures traced to a misapplied file size limit after a configuration change; limit corrected.

subject: Email claiming to be from our CEO asking me to buy gift cards
description: I received an urgent email that looks like it's from our CEO asking me to buy gift cards for a client and send the codes. I haven't replied but it felt wrong.
resolution_steps: Treated the report as legitimate without requiring the requester to prove the email was malicious.
Escalated to the security incident response process for review, as required for all security-classified tickets.
Confirmed sender display-name spoofing of an executive and removed the message from all affected mailboxes.
Blocked the sending domain at the mail gateway and logged the incident timeline for the audit trail.
resolution_summary: Executive impersonation attempt confirmed and contained after security review; message purged and sender domain blocked.
escalation_reason: Every ticket in the Security category is escalated to a human agent; executive impersonation attempts additionally require security review and audit logging.

subject: I entered my credentials on a page that turned out to be fake
description: I clicked a link in an email about a shared document and typed my username and password before I noticed the address looked wrong. I closed it straight away.
resolution_steps: Treated the report as a suspected account compromise given credentials were entered.
Escalated immediately to the security incident response process at P2.
Advised a precautionary password change while the investigation proceeded.
Security reviewed sign-in logs, found no unrecognised activity, and confirmed containment.
resolution_summary: Handled as a suspected compromise; credentials rotated as a precaution and sign-in activity reviewed with no unauthorised access found.
escalation_reason: Requester reported entering credentials on a suspicious site, which is a suspected account compromise requiring immediate escalation without standard password-reset handling.

subject: Suspicious invoice attachment from a sender I don't recognise
description: I got an email with an invoice attachment from a company I've never dealt with. I didn't open the attachment but wanted to report it.
resolution_steps: Treated the report as legitimate and did not require proof of malicious intent from the requester.
Escalated to security for review, as required for every security-classified ticket.
Security analysis confirmed a malicious macro payload in the attachment.
Message removed from all recipient mailboxes, sender blocked, and the incident logged for audit.
resolution_summary: Escalated per policy and confirmed as a malicious attachment campaign; messages purged and sender blocked.
escalation_reason: All Security-category tickets are escalated to a human agent for review, including reported emails the requester did not interact with.

subject: There's a ransom message on my screen and my files won't open
description: My laptop is showing a full screen message demanding payment and none of my documents will open. I don't know what to do.
resolution_steps: Instructed the requester to disconnect the device from the network immediately as a containment step.
Escalated immediately at P1 to security incident response given strong indicators of active ransomware.
Security performed forensic analysis and confirmed the infection scope was limited to the single device.
Device reimaged and data restored from the most recent backup only after it was confirmed clean.
resolution_summary: Ransomware incident contained, escalated at P1, device reimaged and data restored from backup after confirmation the device was clean.
escalation_reason: Strong indicators of active ransomware require immediate P1 escalation to security incident response and mandatory containment.

subject: Antivirus flagged something after I plugged in a USB drive
description: I connected a USB stick a client gave me and the antivirus popped up a warning almost immediately. I removed the drive right away.
resolution_steps: Confirmed the antivirus had automatically quarantined the file before execution.
Escalated at P2 to security for confirmation that the quarantine fully contained the threat.
Security confirmed no execution occurred and no spread to the device or network.
Advised the requester on the handling procedure for externally supplied removable media.
resolution_summary: Escalated for security confirmation; antivirus contained the threat before execution so no reimage was required.
escalation_reason: Antivirus detections are reviewed by the security team to confirm containment; lower-confidence malware signals are escalated at P2.

subject: My work laptop was taken at the airport
description: My bag was taken while I was waiting at the gate. It had my work laptop and my access badge inside. I'm still at the airport.
resolution_steps: Triggered remote lock and wipe on the device immediately upon report.
Escalated at P1 to security incident response given the laptop held significant company data.
Deactivated the associated badge and physical access credentials immediately.
Coordinated with the requester on filing a police report for the incident record, and issued a replacement device.
resolution_summary: Escalated and handled as a P1 security incident; device remotely wiped, badge deactivated, police report filed and replacement issued.
escalation_reason: Stolen laptop containing significant company data requires immediate P1 escalation to security incident response, with badge deactivation as accompanying credentials were also taken.

subject: I think I left my work phone on the train
description: I can't find my work phone and I'm fairly sure I left it on the train this morning. It has my email and the authenticator app on it.
resolution_steps: Triggered a remote wipe of the company data profile via mobile device management immediately.
Escalated to security at P2 as a mobile device with limited but real data exposure.
Revoked the MFA enrolment tied to the lost device and issued a re-enrolment task.
Confirmed the wipe completed and removed the device from active inventory.
resolution_summary: Escalated per lost-device policy; company data profile wiped remotely and MFA enrolment revoked.
escalation_reason: Any lost device containing company data is escalated to security regardless of the likelihood of recovery; mobile devices are handled at P2.

subject: Not receiving emails from one specific external sender
description: A partner agency says they've sent me several emails this week and none of them have arrived. Emails from everyone else come through fine.
resolution_steps: Traced message delivery and found the sender's domain was being blocked at the mail gateway.
Verified with security that the block was a false positive rather than an active threat.
Added the sender domain to the approved list.
Confirmed with the requester that a test message from the agency arrived.
resolution_summary: Missing messages traced to a false-positive gateway block; sender domain allow-listed after verification.

subject: My email signature disappeared after the client was reinstalled
description: IT reinstalled my mail client last week and now my signature is gone, I've been typing it manually since then.
resolution_steps: Confirmed the signature had not been migrated during the client reinstall.
Restored the signature from the user profile backup.
Applied the current company signature template with the requester's details.
Confirmed the signature appeared correctly on a test message.
resolution_summary: Signature restored from profile backup and aligned to the current company template.

subject: Can't send a large proposal attachment and the deadline is today
description: I need to send a proposal deck to a client before the end of the day and the email bounces back saying the attachment is too big.
resolution_steps: Confirmed the attachment exceeded the maximum message size limit.
Guided the requester through sharing the file as a secure cloud link instead of an attachment.
Verified the client could access the shared link externally.
Confirmed the proposal was delivered ahead of the deadline.
resolution_summary: Oversized attachment replaced with a secure cloud share link, delivered before the client deadline.

subject: Need a distribution list for the new onboarding cohort
description: We're onboarding fourteen people this quarter and I'd like a single distribution list so we can send them all the same schedule updates.
resolution_steps: Verified the requester had authority to request the list as the programme owner.
Created the distribution list with the specified members.
Delegated list management rights to the requesting manager.
Confirmed a test message reached all members.
resolution_summary: Distribution list created with delegated management rights and verified with a test message.

subject: Meeting room calendar shows rooms as free when they're booked
description: The room booking calendar says the large meeting room is available but people keep turning up because it's actually booked. We've had two clashes this week.
resolution_steps: Reproduced the discrepancy between the room calendar and the booking system.
Found the room mailbox had stopped auto-processing booking requests after a configuration change.
Restored automatic booking processing on the room mailbox.
Confirmed new bookings appeared correctly and cleared the conflicting entries.
resolution_summary: Room availability discrepancy fixed by restoring automatic booking processing on the room mailbox.

subject: Can't upload files to the team document library
description: I can open and read everything in our team's document library but any upload fails with a permissions message.
resolution_steps: Confirmed the requester held read-only permissions on the library.
Confirmed with the site owner that contribute rights were appropriate for the role.
Updated the requester's permission level to contributor.
Confirmed a test upload completed successfully.
resolution_summary: Upload failures caused by read-only permissions; contributor rights granted after site owner confirmation.

subject: Cloud storage says I'm out of space and stopped syncing
description: My files stopped syncing this morning with a storage full warning. I do keep a lot of build artifacts in there.
resolution_steps: Reviewed storage consumption and confirmed the quota had been reached.
Identified large build artifact folders that did not require cloud sync.
Guided the requester through excluding those folders from sync and archiving old builds.
Confirmed sync resumed and completed for the remaining files.
resolution_summary: Quota exhaustion resolved by excluding build artifacts from sync and archiving old builds; no quota increase required.

subject: Need a private collaboration channel for a confidential matter
description: We're starting work on a matter that should only be visible to four named people. Could you set up a private channel restricted to them?
resolution_steps: Confirmed the requester's authority to request the channel as the matter owner.
Created a private channel restricted to the four named members.
Confirmed the channel and its files were not visible to other team members.
Confirmed all four members could access the channel.
resolution_summary: Private channel created with membership restricted to the four named participants and visibility verified.
